const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };

 "const http=require('http');",
 "const fs=require('fs');",

 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",

 "})();",
].join("\n");

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const fs=require('fs');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // 拉更多 bounty，按仓库聚合，找出批量挂赏金的仓库",
  "  const q='https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=' + encodeURIComponent('is:open label:\"\u{1F48E} Bounty\"') + '&sort=created&order=desc&per_page=100';",
  "  const r=await get(q);",
  "  const j=JSON.parse(r.body);",
  "  console.log('TOTAL:', j.total_count, 'fetched:', j.items.length);",
  "  const byRepo={};",
  "  for(const it of j.items){",
  "    const repo=it.repository_url.split('/repos/')[1];",
  "    if(!byRepo[repo]) byRepo[repo]={count:0, items:[]};",
  "    byRepo[repo].count++;",
  "    byRepo[repo].items.push({num:it.number, title:it.title.substring(0,90), comments:it.comments, url:it.html_url});",
  "  }",
  "  const sorted=Object.entries(byRepo).sort(function(a,b){return b[1].count-a[1].count});",
  "  console.log('\\n=== 批量挂赏金的仓库 TOP 15 ===');",
  "  for(const [repo, d] of sorted.slice(0,15)){",
  "    console.log('\\n['+d.count+' 个] '+repo);",
  "    for(const it of d.items.slice(0,3)){ console.log('    #'+it.num+' ('+it.comments+'评) '+it.title); }",
  "  }",
  "  fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty-repos.json', JSON.stringify(sorted.map(function(x){return {repo:x[0], count:x[1].count}}),null,1));",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-br.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-br.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Aggregate bounty issues by repository", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 8000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
